_comment: npuserv registry.  One entry per model that can go on the ZG330.
'root' is where the 'adapter' paths hang off, relative to this file: .. = lang/,
because the server lives in lang/npuserv and the models live in lang/<kind>/.
Any 件 can be registered that way -- the mechanics in npuserv know nothing about
tokens; model-specific steps stay in the model's own directory as npuserv_adapter.py.
'defaults' is merged under the params of a POST /load; 'env' is set before the
worker is spawned.  Paths here are the BOARD's paths (the server runs on 113), so
artifacts_present in GET /models is a real on-disk check, not a repo check.
No credentials in this file (D-27: a secret value is written once, in its own file).

capabilities.reason_text: board-side via board/e41_tok.py (pure stdlib, reads the prebuilt e41_tok.pack; no tokenizers). Verified on PC id-for-id and string-for-string equal to tokenizers 0.23.3 over 219,085 comparisons (scripts/tok_parity.py, 0 mismatches). Board execution not yet run -- board is not back. The npuserv adapter applies NO chat template: text_in encodes raw text, text_out decodes the generated ids.

models.note: 现役产品链那一颗（台账 #241 同一条路的常驻件）；KV 窗口编死 NS=512 ⇒ 上限 511 槽（e41_chatd.py:61）。窄读是 daemon 里的现役写法，不是旋钮（info.read 报告它）。apply ≈50-95 s。

capabilities.reason_text: text paths call tokenizers.Tokenizer.from_file on the board and have NEVER been executed -- neither generation nor this tokenizer file's loadability is proven (#210 vs #220). Send ids and pass decode:false until the board says otherwise.

models.note: 件在板上叫 Q3V1-、库里叫 Q3I-（同一张图，台账 #208）；库里 board/tokenizer.json 与板上那颗不同一份，分词一律以板上 #210 为准。四档预检到 apply 全过，生成从未跑过 ⇒ 这条 adapter 是写好未验证的状态，而且它依赖的 patch/q3_infer_board.py 也从没上过板（#208-#211 那次 push 只有 json/raw/tokenizer 三份）。点火要推三件：npuserv/、这颗 adapter、q3_infer_board.py。pos_rule=vendor 逐字复现厂商 run_prompt＋run_decode 两条循环（Qwen2 出通顺中文用的就是这套位置口径）；uniform 是消融档。

capabilities.reason_text: no NPU, no icraft: replays ids and sleeps load_ms/step_ms so the server, the protocol and the lifecycle get tested on a PC
